what: a surface revolve (360 deg) of a stepped open profile whose lines alternate square to and along the axis: truck split the flat rings into several faces at odd angles
method: two flat rings (r 10..20 at z 0, r 20..30 at z 10) and two cylinders (r 20, r 30): 4 faces, one per line. Area = pi (20^2-10^2) + pi (30^2-20^2) + 2 pi 20 10 + 2 pi 30 10 = 1800 pi. An open sheet, not a solid
